appearances.title: v0.25.0
appearances.summary: 0.25.0 (2026-11-17) Key Changes Version 0.25.0 removes the beta Runloop sandbox provider and changes how Pydantic run contexts are checkpointed. Runloop users should preserve their workspace data before switching providers. Applications that share checkpoints across workers should upgrade readers first. appearances.headline: OpenAI Agents SDK preview ships native runtime wheels
appearances.newly_possible: You can install an Agents SDK preview with a native runtime included, with no Rust toolchain or source build, from GitHub Releases.
